parameters.name: AckLabels
parameters.description: The list of labels for pods in the ACK cluster.

parameters.name: AckNamespaces
parameters.description: The list of namespaces for pods in the ACK cluster.

parameters.name: AddressList
parameters.description: The addresses in the address book. Separate multiple addresses with commas (,). Use a space to separate an address from its description. This parameter is required when GroupType is set to **ip**, **port**, or **domain**.

parameters.name: AssetMemberUids
parameters.description: The list of member accounts in the asset address book.

parameters.name: AssetRegionResourceTypes
parameters.description: The cloud address book, including the list of regions and resource types.

parameters.name: AutoAddTagEcs
parameters.description: Indicates whether the public IP addresses of Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances that match the specified tags are automatically added to the address book.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the address book.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description: Specifies whether to perform a dry run.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the address book.

parameters.name: GroupUuid
parameters.description: The unique ID of the address book.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.

sub_parameters.name: TagKey
sub_parameters.description: The key of the ECS tag.

sub_parameters.name: TagValue
sub_parameters.description: The value of the ECS tag.

parameters.name: TagRelation
parameters.description: The logical relationship among multiple ECS tags.
